question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually launched a cooperative society in Bihar to provide easy access to funds at affordable interest rates to community members in September 2025, named ______.

options.text: Bihar Rajya Krishi Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited
Bihar Rajya Mahila Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited
Bihar Rajya Jeevika Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited
Bihar Rajya Gramin Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited

solution: The correct answer is __**Bihar Rajya Jeevika Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** launched a cooperative society in Bihar named **Bihar Rajya Jeevika Nidhi Saakh Sahkari Sangh Limited** in **September 2025**. • The primary aim of this initiative is to provide **easy access to funds** at affordable interest rates to the members of the community in Bihar. • This cooperative society is designed to **empower rural communities** by offering financial support, particularly to economically weaker sections. • The cooperative society aligns with the government’s vision of enhancing rural financial inclusion and strengthening the cooperative sector in India. • The society will play a crucial role in supporting **livelihood activities** and promoting self-reliance among rural populations in Bihar.
